suggestions.title: Fix Flutter lint warnings — use_build_context_synchronously in video_download_screen
suggestions.description: lib/screens/parent/video_download_screen.dart:447/453 has two use_build_context_synchronously warnings. The BuildContext is used across async gaps guarded by unrelated mounted checks. Fix by capturing context in a local variable before the async operation.

suggestions.title: Fix Flutter lint warnings — leading underscores in video_download_screen local vars
suggestions.description: lib/screens/parent/video_download_screen.dart:859/878/894 has three no_leading_underscores_for_local_identifiers warnings for _batchDownloadLocal, _batchCopyLinks, _batchReDownloadConfirm. Rename to batchDownloadLocal, batchCopyLinks, batchReDownloadConfirm.

suggestions.title: Add AI service test coverage for SSE streaming paths
suggestions.description: ai.service.ts (3077 lines) has partial coverage via ai.service.core.spec.ts (59 tests). Need to verify SSE streaming methods (streamChat, streamCoursePack) are covered by existing tests. If not, add tests.
